cipherchannels.notice.command_plaintext: Commands are not encrypted by CipherChannels.
cipherchannels.chat.status.command_plain: Command will be sent as plaintext

cipherchannels.chat.hover.wire: Exact encrypted message sent over chat:
cipherchannels.block.no_key: Blocked — no session key for %s. Re-import its invite or turn encryption off.
cipherchannels.block.binding: Suspended — the active channel is bound to %s. Nothing was sent.
cipherchannels.block.empty: Blocked — the normalized message is empty.
cipherchannels.block.unicode: Blocked — the draft contains malformed Unicode. Nothing was sent.
cipherchannels.block.source_too_large: Blocked — the draft is %s UTF-8 bytes; the restored-text limit is 4,096.
cipherchannels.block.does_not_fit: Blocked — %s UTF-8 bytes still do not fit after compression (raw capacity %s). Nothing was sent.
cipherchannels.block.vanilla_limit: Blocked — plaintext chat exceeds Minecraft's 256-character limit. Shorten it or turn encrypted chat on.
cipherchannels.block.command_limit: Blocked — commands retain Minecraft's 256-character limit. The complete draft was preserved.
cipherchannels.block.encryption_failed: Blocked — encryption failed safely. Nothing was sent.
cipherchannels.block.unknown: Blocked — CipherChannels could not safely send this message.
